title: Part 1 — Patient: register and submit a request

rows.step: Open the portal and choose **Register**. Enter the Patient Access Code (`MAPA-YYYY-NNNNN`) issued in person by Medical Social Services.
rows.expected: Code is accepted; registration form opens. An invalid/used code is rejected.

rows.step: Complete registration (name, email, password) and sign in.
rows.expected: Account is created; patient lands on **Dashboard**.

rows.step: Start a new **Request** — enter the bill amount, PhilHealth deduction, and any other payments.
rows.expected: The amount-needed is computed as *bill − PhilHealth − other* (Order of Charging).

rows.step: Complete the **Household Intake** wizard and upload the required documents + a live selfie.
rows.expected: Each required document type shows as attached; selfie is camera-only (no gallery upload).
Request status becomes **Submitted / Under Review**; it appears under **Status**.

rows.step: During the **remote assessment**, respond to Medical Social Services through the in-app conversation (and join the on-demand Google Meet link only if one is sent).
rows.expected: Messages reach the social worker; no appointment is booked — the assessment is asynchronous.

rows.step: Sign in as CRMC staff and open **Requests**. Locate the submitted request.
rows.expected: Request is listed with its documents and status.

rows.step: Open the request and run **document verification** (OCR-assisted). Compare the live selfie to the ID.
rows.expected: OCR name shows as an advisory cross-check; social worker confirms/rejects each document.

rows.step: Conduct the **remote assessment** — reach the patient through the in-app conversation (drop an on-demand Google Meet link only if a live talk is needed) — and complete the **Unified Intake Sheet**.
rows.expected: Intake sheet saves; once documents are verified AND intake is complete the request is ready to endorse.

rows.step: **Endorse** the request to one or more funding agencies (pure selection — no per-agency amounts).
rows.expected: Child application "slices" are created, each endorsed for the full amount needed; a single agency cannot approve past the need, though CRMC may intentionally over-endorse across agencies for a buffer. The patient is notified.

rows.step: Confirm the request status reflects the endorsement.
rows.expected: Status becomes **Endorsed**; each slice appears for its agency.

title: Part 3 — Agency: fund and issue the Guarantee Letter

rows.step: Sign in as the agency coordinator and open the **Application Inbox**.
rows.expected: The endorsed slice appears (patient having proceeded), marked **For Funding**.

rows.step: Open the application detail and review the endorsed amount against the agency budget.
rows.expected: Detail + timeline render; remaining budget is shown.
Approval is capped at the endorsed slice amount; over-commitment beyond remaining budget is blocked; the agency budget is decremented and the request advances (partially/fully funded).

rows.step: Confirm the **Guarantee Letter** is issued at approval.
rows.expected: A GL (digital certificate) is generated for the approved slice.

title: Part 4 — Patient: receive and download the Guarantee Letter

rows.step: As the patient, open **Status** and view the coverage plan.
rows.expected: Coverage shows the approved slice(s) and any remaining balance.
The GL downloads successfully and shows the correct patient, agency, and amount.
The patient can see who accessed their data and export their own record.
